main_text.p: Valdè, vehementer: Syr. sequente ܐܠܦ est Potius, Magis quàm, ut 2. ad Tim. 3.4. ad Hebr. 3.3. ܐܠܦ Quamvis, Etiamsi, ad Hebr. 5.8.
טבאות, טבאות Chald. Idem, Deut. 9.21. & Deut. 17.4. in Targ. Jon.
טובא, טוב Ch. & Syr. Bonum, bonitas, præstantia: Felicitas, beatitudo. Plur. טובין, טובי.
טבותא, טבות Ch. Bonum, bonitas. Sic Syr. ad Ephes. 5. 9. Plur. טבון, טבותא.
Syr. Beatus, Felix, Act. 26.2. Jac. 1.25. Plural.
Syr. Apparatus, præparatio, promptitudo, ad Ephes. 6.15. & 2. ad Cor. 9.2.
טיבא Ch. Bonum. Amos. 9.4. Vide quoque supra in טבב. Cum Aff. ומה טיבכון Et quod est bonum vestrum? id est, quid prodest vobis? Cant. 7.1.
טוז טוויא Ch. Idem quod טפויא Cuniculus, Levit. 11.5. in Targ. Jon. Sic reperitur אופשר & אפשר.
טוח Aphel אטח Ch. Ejaculari, ejicere, ולא אטח במלין, Neque ejecit verba, id est, obloquutus est, Genes. 15.6. Jonath.

טול Ch. Hinnire, Heb. צהל, mutato ץ in ט, Jer. 50. 11. ubi Regia habent תצולון. Pahel טייל Ch. Ambulare, deambulare, spaciari, incedere: Ex geminatis litteris טלטל, Tollere, ejicere, evellere, transferre, transportare,

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Aramaic words are transcribed approximately from the scan; the Syriac and Hebrew vowel-pointing is only partly legible and is marked as far as it could be read. Some Hebrew forms in the Aramaic lines are uncertain and should be checked against the original.
